mapper.select: SELECT p.id FROM vi_integration_profile p JOIN sys_dept company ON company.dept_id=p.owner_dept_id AND company.status='0' AND company.del_flag='0' JOIN vi_station s ON s.id=#{stationId} AND s.enabled=1 JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id=s.dept_id AND d.status='0' AND d.del_flag='0' WHERE p.kind='PAYMENT_POLICY' AND p.config_key='DEFAULT' AND p.environment=#{environment} AND p.lifecycle!='RETIRED' AND (company.dept_id=d.dept_id OR FIND_IN_SET(company.dept_id,d.ancestors)>0) ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id,p.owner_dept_id,p.kind,p.environment,p.lifecycle,p.active_revision_id,r.config_json,r.secret_refs_json,r.content_hash FROM vi_integration_profile p JOIN vi_integration_revision r ON r.id=p.active_revision_id AND r.profile_id=p.id WHERE p.id=#{id} AND p.lifecycle='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
